title: Analytics Effects and the dev double log

slides.say: You log a page visit in an Effect, and in development every visit is logged twice.
The docs recommend keeping this code as it is. There is no user visible difference between logging once and twice.

slides.text: Dev logs shouldn’t reach production metrics anyway. Production has no duplicates.
slides.say: Your dev machine should not send real analytics anyway, and the component remounts on every file save. In production, there are no duplicate logs.

slides.text: Debugging events? Use a staging (production-mode) build, or opt out of Strict Mode for a while.
slides.say: To debug the events, deploy to a staging environment in production mode, or temporarily opt out of Strict Mode.
